# `get_source`

Fetch ABAP source code for an object (program, class, interface, etc.) with optional version, include, method-level, grep filtering, or structured output.

Defined in [`packages/adt-mcp/src/lib/tools/get-source.ts`](https://github.com/abapify/adt-cli/blob/main/packages/adt-mcp/src/lib/tools/get-source.ts).

## Input schema

| Parameter    | Type                     | Required | Description                                                                                                              |
| ------------ | ------------------------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `baseUrl`    | `string`                 | no       | SAP system base URL (e.g. https://host:8000)                                                                             |
| `client`     | `string`                 | no       | SAP client number                                                                                                        |
| `username`   | `string`                 | no       | Username for basic auth                                                                                                  |
| `password`   | `string`                 | no       | Password for basic auth                                                                                                  |
| `systemId`   | `string`                 | no       | Logical system id (resolved via multi-system config or ~/.adt sessions)                                                  |
| `objectName` | `string`                 | yes      | ABAP object name                                                                                                         |
| `objectType` | `string`                 | no       | Object type (e.g. PROG, CLAS, INTF). Speeds up URI resolution when known.                                                |
| `version`    | `"active" \| "inactive"` | no       | Source version: active (default, last activated) or inactive (unactivated draft). Default: `"active"`.                   |
| `include`    | `string`                 | no       | For CLAS: source include such as definitions, implementations, testclasses, macros, localtypes, text_symbols, or main.   |
| `method`     | `string`                 | no       | For CLAS: method name to read, or "*" to list all methods.                                                               |
| `grep`       | `string`                 | no       | Regex pattern; returns only matching source lines with context instead of full source.                                   |
| `maxBytes`   | `integer`                | no       | Maximum UTF-8 response size in bytes (default 1048576, hard cap 2097152). Oversized source is rejected, never truncated. |
| `format`     | `"raw" \| "structured"`  | no       | Output format: raw source text, or structured JSON with class includes and method boundaries. Default: `"raw"`.          |

## Output

The tool returns a single text content item whose body is a JSON-serialised object (`content[0].text`). On error, the response has `isError: true` and a human-readable message.

```json
{
  "content": [{ "type": "text", "text": "<JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)>" }]
}
```

See the source for the exact shape of `result`.

## Example invocation

```json
{
  "name": "get_source",
  "arguments": {
    "baseUrl": "https://sap.example.com:44300",
    "username": "DEVELOPER",
    "password": "***",
    "client": "100",
    "objectName": "<objectName>"
  }
}
```
